system.description:
Secret (treaty-book). Study: a caster who can cast Bind Elemental; 6 weeks, DC 15.

Teaches: binding one elemental for good, of Level up to half yours; genies can't be bound this way.

The work: a 1-day ritual in a prepared circle with offerings of its element worth its Level × 50 gp; it makes Bind Elemental's save or is bound.

  • It serves until you break the terms: an offering worth its Level × 1 gp each month, or it goes free and hostile.
  • A treaty-book from the City of Brass setting out the terms on which an elemental may be bound.
  • The efreet wrote it to bind others, never themselves.

Monsters & Treasure, Secrets: one of a kind, never sold, placed by the GM. Studied in downtime (Study a Secret); no one can teach it.
